name: SQLITE_MASTER_AFTER_CREATE_TABLE
description: sqlite_master records the new table with type='table'

name: SQLITE_MASTER_AFTER_CREATE_INDEX
description: CREATE INDEX adds a row with type='index' tied to its table

name: SQLITE_MASTER_AFTER_CREATE_VIEW
description: CREATE VIEW yields a sqlite_master row of type='view'

name: SQLITE_MASTER_AFTER_CREATE_TRIGGER
description: CREATE TRIGGER yields a sqlite_master row of type='trigger'

name: SQLITE_SCHEMA_ALIAS
description: sqlite_schema is an alias of sqlite_master and returns same rows

name: SQLITE_SEQUENCE_AUTOINCREMENT
description: sqlite_sequence tracks the max rowid for an AUTOINCREMENT table

name: SQLITE_STAT1_AFTER_ANALYZE
description: ANALYZE populates sqlite_stat1 with one row per analyzed index

name: PRAGMA_TABLE_INFO_TVF
PRAGMA_TABLE_XINFO_INCLUDES_GENERATED
description: pragma_table_xinfo adds a 'hidden' column and exposes generated cols

name: PRAGMA_INDEX_LIST_TVF
description: pragma_index_list('t') lists indexes on the table with uniqueness flag

name: PRAGMA_INDEX_INFO_TVF
description: pragma_index_info('idx') lists columns in index order

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEY_LIST_TVF
description: pragma_foreign_key_list('c') reports parent/child columns and actions

name: PRAGMA_DATABASE_LIST_DEFAULT
description: pragma_database_list shows main and temp schemas by default
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT seq, name FROM pragma_database_list ORDER BY seq;

name: PRAGMA_FUNCTION_LIST_FILTERED
description: pragma_function_list filtered to a specific function name
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT name FROM pragma_function_list WHERE name='abs';

name: PRAGMA_COLLATION_LIST
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT name FROM pragma_collation_list ORDER BY name;

name: PRAGMA_MODULE_LIST_FILTER
description: pragma_module_list returns virtual-table modules; filter by prefix
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
SELECT name FROM pragma_module_list WHERE name LIKE 'fts%' ORDER BY name;
expected_stdout:
fts3
fts3tokenize
fts4
fts4aux
fts5
fts5vocab

name: PRAGMA_WRITABLE_SCHEMA_DEFAULT_OFF
description: PRAGMA writable_schema; reports 0 by default (read-only check)

name: PRAGMA_TABLE_LIST_TEMP_AND_TEMP_MASTER
description: pragma_table_list filtered to temp + sqlite_temp_master after CREATE TEMP TABLE
